subject.title: Himalaya skill: missing email formatting philosophy and incorrect command syntax

question: Should resolution be owned by the active Himalaya removal/externalization path, with a v2-compatible ClawHub skill required as the durable replacement?
rationale: The current bundled docs are demonstrably wrong, but the proposed expansion targets upstream v1 behavior while repository vision and an active maintainer PR move optional skills out of core.

options.title: Externalize for v2
options.body: Keep this issue open until the removal path lands or identifies a maintained ClawHub bundle with corrected Himalaya v2 and standalone MML guidance.

options.title: Apply interim corrections
options.body: If removal will be delayed, fix only the verified copy/move and export examples in the bundled skill and avoid adding obsolete v1 guidance.

recommendation.title: Externalize for v2
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until the removal path lands or identifies a maintained ClawHub bundle with corrected Himalaya v2 and standalone MML guidance.

likelyOwner.reason: The active skill-trimming pull request controls the immediate repository boundary and therefore the durable location of the fix.
